name: metabase
title_zh: 把数据库变成人人能问问题的自助分析台
tagline_zh: 业务同事不再排队等报表，自己拖拽就能看数。开源、可嵌入自家系统，连 SQL 都不用写，像用 Excel 透视表一样。
tagline_en: Let your team explore data themselves—no SQL, no queueing for reports. Open-source, embeddable, and as familiar.
desc_en: The easy-to-use open source Business Intelligence and Embedded Analytics tool that lets everyone work with data :bar_chart:
why_zh: 它把「问数据」的门槛降到双击字段、拖拽维度，同时保留 SQL 后门给进阶者。元数据层自动建模。
why_en: It turns data questions into drag-and-drop moves, with a SQL escape hatch for power users. Auto-modeled metadata keeps.
limit_zh: 只覆盖「看数」这一环：不负责数据清洗、不替代数仓。数据源得先有人接好、表结构得先有人整理，否则拖出来的数字会骗人。
limit_en: Covers viewing only—no ETL, no warehouse. Someone must connect sources and model tables first, or your drag-and-drop numbers will mislead.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
